body:
## Purpose

A hybrid KV cache that quantizes full-attention layers but keeps sliding-window layers in higher precision (`--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers sliding_window`) produces **NaN / all-zero output** once the input exceeds the sliding window. Uniform fp8 and bf16 are fine; only the hybrid combo fails (seen on Blackwell + FlashInfer).

## Root cause

Attention groups share one block pool. The sliding-window group frees blocks mid-request; those pages get reallocated to the fp8 group and read back including slots not written this step. As bf16 that leftover is harmless
garbage, but as **fp8 it decodes to NaN/Inf** and corrupts attention. The existing zeroing guard (`needs_kv_cache_zeroing`) was gated only on Mamba (#35219), so this config was left exposed.

## Fix

Extend `needs_kv_cache_zeroing` to also fire for block-dropping attention (sliding-window / chunked-local) + quantized (FP8/NVFP4) KV cache:

```python
needs_kv_cache_zeroing = has_mamba_layers or (has_block_dropping_layers and has_quantized_kv_cache)
```

Uniform / unquantized caches stay `False` → zero overhead.

## Test Plan
- Run RULER (`niah_single_1`) evals on `CohereLabs/command-a-plus-05-2026-w4a4` with various kv cache quantization options, before and after the fix.
- Here are the repro steps on B200, FlashInfer backend, `lm-eval-harness` 0.4.x.

Serve the hybrid config:

```bash
vllm serve CohereLabs/command-a-plus-05-2026-w4a4 \
  --tool-call-parser cohere_command4 --reasoning-parser cohere_command4 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers sliding_window
```

2. Run the needle eval (repeat with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` alone, and with no
`--kv-cache-dtype` flag for the bf16 reference):

```bash
lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args "base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,model=CohereLabs/command-a-plus-05-2026-w4a4,num_concurrent=32,tokenized_requests=False" \
  --tasks niah_single_1 \
  --metadata '{"max_seq_lengths":[4096,32768,131072],"tokenizer":"CohereLabs/command-a-plus-05-2026-w4a4"}' \
  --gen_kwargs "temperature=0.9,top_p=0.95,repetition_penalty=1.04" \
  --trust_remote_code
```

## Test Result

| KV cache config             | 4K    | 32K   | 132K   |
| --------------------------- | --------- | --------- | --------- |
| bf16 (reference)            | 0.994     | 0.388     | 0.556     |
| fp8 uniform                 | 0.994     | 0.376     | 0.462     |
| fp8 + skip-SWA **w/o fix**  | **0.002** | **0.000** | **0.002** |
| fp8 + skip-SWA **with fix** | **0.990** | **0.376** | **0.520** |

title: [Bugfix] Zero new KV blocks for quantized + sliding-window hybrid caches
